title: Logix debug configuration, version 1
description:
A debug configuration file: which nets the debugger reads and drives, how
it reaches the host and which clock it runs on.

$schema.description:
This schema's address, for editors. Optional; any other value is
refused.

clock.description:
The clock the debugger and its UART run on: a top-level input port of
the design, such as sys_clk. Every input and output net must be on
it.

clock_mhz.description:
The clock's frequency in MHz. Needed only when the clock port isn't
on the board's clock pin, whose frequency the catalog gives.

uplink.description:
How the debugger reaches the host. Omitted means the board's UART at
115200 baud.

kind.description: The kind of link; only uart in version 1.

tx.description:
The FPGA pin the debugger transmits on. Defaults to the board's UART
TX pin in the catalog.

rx.description:
The FPGA pin the debugger receives on. Defaults to the board's UART
RX pin in the catalog.

net.description:
The net: its instance path and name before flattening, such as
u_ctrl.state, or just its name in the top module, such as count.

name.description: The host's name for it. Defaults to the net.

net.description: The net, named as for inputs.

name.description: The host's name for it. Defaults to the net.

mode.description:
override: the debugger can take over a net the design drives, and
release it back. register: the debugger always drives it. Defaults
to override.
